row: Nirvana Mustang Sanctuary & Kind Horse Training

Nirvana Mustang Sanctuary works to save Mustangs from at risk slaughter situations, and provide them a better life! We re-wild mustangs with no chance elsewhere, educate about the wild horse issue, and teach empathic relationship based training methods to inspire others to adopt their own lifelong mustang parter and have the confidence to connect with and train their own equine partner in an ethical, horse-centered manner!

Nirvana Mustang Sanctuary is a 501(c)3 charity organization home to 600+ mustangs. We are located in East Texas! You can learn more about the sanctuary at www.nirvanamustangsanctuary.org

Be sure to check out "The Ultimate Guide to Connecting with Any Horse", a course that is filled with the most valuable information that will enable you to connect with absolutely ANY horse and transform your time with them into something MAGICAL! Check out the course here: https://www.kindhorsetraining.com/offers/FPc4EZSs/checkout

Be sure to subscribe! 🚨
